About Bspoke Brighton

Brighton’s chair. Brighton’s barbers.

Bspoke Barbershop is a premium men’s barbershop at 405 Bay St, Brighton VIC 3186. This page is for the Brighton shop only.

Services: standard cuts, clipper fades, mod and scissor cuts, restyles, buzz cuts, beard trims, shaves and precision fades.

Phone: 0478 626 141 (directory listing). Email: info@bspokebarbershop.com.au (directory-published).

Questions

Before you sit down

How much is a fade?

Clipper fades start from $60 at the Brighton shop; precision fades are also from $60.

What is the cheapest cut?

A buzz cut (no fades) starts from $30. A standard short back & sides starts from $50.

Do you do beard trims and shaves?

Yes — beard trims and shaves are offered alongside cuts.

Which shop is this page for?

The Brighton shop at 405 Bay St, Brighton VIC 3186.

When are you open?

Tuesday to Wednesday 9am–5:30pm, Thursday to Friday 9am–7pm, Saturday 9am–6pm, Sunday 9am–4pm.
